SECTION 1. Title 17 ofthe Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing all of the M2-2 Light Industry District symbols and indications as shown on
Map No. 2-K in the area bounded by

      A line 516.40 feet north of and parallel to West Roosevelt Road, South Kolmar Avenue; West
      Roosevelt Road; and a line 110.00 feet west of and parallel to South Kolmar Avenue

lo those of an M3-2 Heavy Industry District.

12.   Reason for rezoning the property To establish a Recycling Facility Class V operation in coniuction

       with its current wholesale and retail landscape materials business.



13.   Describe the proposed use of the property after the rezoning. Indicate the number of dwelling
      units; number of parking spaces; approximate square footage ofany commercial space; and
      height ofthe proposed building. (BE SPECIFIC)
      To establish a Recycling Facility Class V facility, at a site with an existing 1-story building containing approximately
      1,952.00 sq. ft. and which is currently approved for a Contractor/Construction Storage Yard and Building Material Sales.
      The Recycling Facility Class V requires a special use from the ZBA. The Applicant seeks to be allowed to accept dirt,
      concrete, brick and block from customers for recycling at the site or to ship to re-processors. The location is within the
      Roosevelt/Cicero Industrial Corridor. The existing buildings are to remain unchanged. There will be no residential use.
      The site has 7 existing parking spaces.


14.   The Affordable Requrements Ordinance (ARO) requires on-site affordable housing units and/or
      a financial contribution for residential housing projects with ten or more units that receive a zoning
      change which, among other triggers, increases the allowable floor area, or, for existing Planned
      Developments, increases the number of units (see attached fact sheet or visit
      www.cityofchicago.org/ARO for more information). Is this project subject to the ARO?


      YES                                  NO
